mentions.name: Chief
mentions.description: A CLI that autonomously works through a PRD using AI coding agents like Claude Code. It loops through user stories one at a time with fresh context per story, tracks progress in markdown between iterations, and makes one clean commit per completed story. Includes a TUI for watching it work and supports running multiple PRDs in parallel via git worktrees. Everything is stored as markdown files and git, keeping the tool lightweight and transparent.
mentions.problem: Existing "autonomous coding" tooling felt overly complex and opaque; Chief is intentionally lightweight and transparent with no magic.
